description.en: Original preserved Pteleoidea fruit organ only: a raised fusiform central locule joins two coplanar broad wings forming an obovate notched outline, a modest apical style and a narrow retained pedicel. Thin folded wing relief, nominal45mm span and quiet color are artistic. No funnel calyx, separate seed, known parent tree, leaves or precise phylogenetic claim.
